弹确认框后清掉本行的用户覆盖，回到内置绑定并写入 keybindings.jso: After confirmation, clear this row's user override, restore the built-in binding, and write keybindings.json.
弹确认框后把本行的**所有**绑定（含内置/插件默认键）一并清掉——这条命令从此: After confirmation, clear **all** bindings for this row (including built-in/plugin defaults)—the command then has no key, and author-declared defaults do not come back automatically (use Reset to Default to restore them). Writes { command, key: "" } to keybindings.json. Requires LinkDesk 0.2.46+; hidden on older shells.

Called from the gear menu on the Needs Your Choice row. Requires LinkDesk 0.2.48+ (writes N types at once); older shells degrade to per-type writes with the same result.
